name: Display Suite Chains
description: Place a field from a referenced entity directly in a Display Suite layout, using any applicable field formatter.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Provides chained fields for entity reference fields and display suite.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 tl;dr - If you need to place a field of a referenced entity amongst other fields - use this module.

e.g. With this module you can move the author picture around on the manage display tab for nodes.

 If your entity has an entity reference field, you can access any fields from the referenced entity type on your manage display tab.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Display suite 

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 Refer to the documentation 

 Back to top 

 Known problems 
 Please use the issue queue to report problems.

 Back to top 

 Similar modules 
 
 Field formatter provides the ability to configure a single field from a referenced entity on an entity reference field. The difference is that Display Suite Chained Fields lets you configure each field on its own, whereas field formatter only supports a single field.
